description: List zv1 routines — scheduled natural-language instructions run by zv1. Returns each routine's id, name, instruction, cadence, delivery, enabled state, and last-run outcome. Check this before creating a routine so you don't duplicate one that already exists.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: routines_list
title: List the workspace's routines
